correctness.rationale: For q>=3 and epsilon≠0,epsilon_q, the rational Euler critical-point map R_epsilon(t)=−t f’/f has degree q because numerator and denominator are coprime. Differentiation yields numerator 1+q²epsilon t^{q−1}+(q−1)²epsilon t^q, whose q finite zeros are simple except epsilon_q. Infinity has local index q−1 over −q. Elimination yields D_q(r,epsilon), and the parameter map E_q(r)=epsilon_q(r+1)^q/(r^{q−1}(r+q)) has exactly 0, infinity, epsilon_q as branch values with partitions (q),(q−1,1),(2,1^{q−2}); degree and total ramification meet Riemann–Hurwitz. The rational covers are connected and the cycle of length q−1 with a transposition connecting its fixed label generates full S_q. Independent exact symbolic differentiation/discriminant calculations for q=3..8 agree; all-q proof follows from symbolic formulas and divisor argument, not finite q checks. Resonant infinity branch is not a finite very-affine collision.
